findings.body:
Under -short, internal/cli is the gate's long pole: 154s of the uncached gate's 162s here, and 120s alone. Of that, 472 top-level tests run serially, summing ~78s, because 158 t.Setenv and 12 os.Chdir/t.Chdir lines bar t.Parallel(). The other ~40s is z7w's property tests, which zi6 owns. Thread the env and cwd inputs through the command's options, as yzk proposes for subprocess and herdr and as Options.Procs/Now already do, so the tests can join the parallel pack. With zi6, cli and so the gate should drop toward ~1 min. It does not move t8u's A1 (reconcile is that floor).
evidence: go test -short -count=1 -parallel 12 -json ./internal/cli/: wall 120s; serial top-level tests 472 summing 78.0s; grep -c 't.Setenv(' internal/cli/*_test.go = 158
findings.title: Parallelise internal/cli's 472 serial tests: the per-tick gate's floor

findings.body:
x73 left runstate as a follow-on. Measured now: -short 6.5s (no gate win), full suite 41s with 84 serial top-level tests summing 39s. Only remote_flap_test.go and http_stall_test.go use t.Setenv; the rest just never call t.Parallel(). The win is go-touched's full-suite run on ticks that touch runstate, about 41s down to under 10s. Low: reconcile, which imports it, is left to CI, so A1 does not move.
evidence: go test -count=1 -parallel 12 -json ./internal/runstate/: wall 41s, serial tests 84 summing 39.35s
findings.title: Parallelise internal/runstate's 84 serial tests (full suite 41s)

response.summary: t8u's [A1] is unmet (both reviews NOT READY, bound spent); an operator must re-scope A1 on t8u or bring kf1/9xx in (xju). The gate figures were measured under load 6.5-15, not on a quiet host.
